title: 第23章 神技第24章 枭雄落幕
slug: 游戏入侵开局挖掌天瓶
content_zh:
第23章神技
午后的阳光有些刺眼。
苏寒跨出青叶城玄衣卫千户所高高的青石门槛。阳光照在他崭新的黑色制式官服上，反射出一种冷硬、肃杀的光泽。腰间的精钢雁翎刀随着步伐轻轻晃动，发出低沉的金属碰撞声。
街上的行人，无论是挑担的商贩，还是持剑的江湖客，在看到这身黑皮的瞬间，全都像避瘟神一样远远地躲开，生怕沾染上半点晦气。
权力的气息，比任何猛兽都要好用。
苏寒没有在意周围人敬畏与恐惧的目光。他一边走，一边在脑海中唤出系统面板。
【姓名：苏寒】
【职业：玄衣卫·白役（九品下）】
【等级：11】
【自由属性点：2】
【力量：13】
【敏捷：5】
【精神：13】（基础11+职业补正2）
【生命值：190190】
这是释放底蕴池转职后，尚未分配的初始状态。那2点自由属性点，静静地躺在面板底部，等待着他的决断。
“全部加在精神上。”
没有任何犹豫，苏寒下达了指令。
【精神：13→15】
“嗡——”
大脑深处传来一阵极其舒适的清凉感。15点的精神力，让苏寒感觉自己仿佛脱胎换骨。他的感知范围再次向外扩张，十米内哪怕是一只苍蝇振翅的轨迹，都在他的脑海中清晰可见。对体内《八部天龙诀》真气的操控，更是达到了如臂使指的入微境界。

但更让他期待的，是那个刚刚解锁的职业神技。
苏寒停在一个十字路口，目光锁定在街角一个正在收保护费的泼皮身上。那泼皮满脸横肉，正一脚将一个卖菜的老农踹翻在地，抢走对方钱袋里的几枚铜板。
“洞察。”苏寒在心底默念。
只消耗了一丝极其微弱的精神力，苏寒的瞳孔深处再次闪过那一抹妖异的暗金色流光。
下一秒，在苏寒的视网膜上，那名泼皮的头顶上方，凭空浮现出了一块只有他自己能看到的、刺目的血红色半透明面板。
【目标对象：李麻子（青叶城地痞）】
【近72小时内罪恶违禁记录：】
1.两个时辰前，于城南后巷，民女一名，致其重伤。
2.昨夜子时，偷窃城西当铺库房，盗取白银十两。
3.三天前，聚众斗殴，持刀砍断他人左手。
这些血红色的字迹，不仅详细记录了时间、地点，甚至连作案的手段和隐藏的赃款位置，都清清楚楚地罗列在上面！
content_en:
Chapter 23 Magical Skills
The afternoon sun was a bit harsh.
Su Han stepped out of the high bluestone threshold of Qingye City's Xuanyi Guard House. The sun shone on his brand new black official uniform, reflecting a cold, chilling luster. The fine steel Yan Fei Dao at his waist swayed slightly with his steps, making a low metal collision sound.
Pedestrians on the street, whether they were vendors carrying burdens or charlatans holding swords, the moment they saw this black leather suit, they all stayed away like the god of plague, for fear of being exposed to any bad luck.
The breath of power is easier to use than any beast.
Su Han didn't pay attention to the awe and fear in the eyes of the people around him. As he walked, he called up the system panel in his mind.
[Name: Su Han]
[Occupation: Xuanyiwei Baiyi (lower ninth grade)]
【Level: 11】
[Free attribute points: 2]
【Strength: 13】
[Agility: 5]
[Spirit: 13] (Basic 11 + Professional Supplement 2)
[Health value: 190190]
This is the initial state that has not yet been allocated after the foundation pool is released and transferred. Those two free attribute points were lying quietly at the bottom of the panel, waiting for his decision.
“Put it all on the spirit.”
Without any hesitation, Su Han gave the order.
【Spirit: 13→15】
"Buzz——"
An extremely comfortable cooling sensation came from the depths of my brain. With 15 points of mental power, Su Han felt as if he had been reborn. His range of perception expanded outward again, and even the trajectory of a fly's wings within ten meters was clearly visible in his mind. The control of the true energy of the "Eight Parts of Heavenly Dragon Art" in the body has reached a subtle state like using arms and fingers.
But what he was looking forward to even more was the newly unlocked professional skill.
Su Han stopped at an intersection and locked his eyes on a gangster who was collecting protection money at the corner. The scoundrel, with a sinister face, was kicking an old vegetable seller to the ground and snatching away a few coins from his wallet.
"Insight." Su Han muttered silently in his heart.
With only a trace of extremely weak mental power consumed, the strange dark golden light flashed through the depths of Su Han's pupils again.
The next second, on Su Han's retina, a dazzling blood-red translucent panel appeared out of thin air above the rogue's head that only he could see.
[Target: Li Mazi (Aoba City ruffian)]
[Crime and prohibition records in the past 72 hours:]
1. Two hours ago, a civilian girl was seriously injured in a back alley in the south of the city.
2. At midnight last night, he robbed the warehouse of a pawnshop in the west of the city and stole ten taels of silver.
3. Three days ago, a crowd got into a fight and cut off someone's left hand with a knife.
These blood-red writings not only recorded the time and location in detail, but also clearly listed the means of committing the crime and the location of the hidden stolen money!
